fact_text: A new oil discovery at Nashpa was reported in early January 2026 with flow of about 4,100 barrels of oil per day, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: OGDC is the operator of the Nashpa discovery with a 65 percent stake, PPL holds about 30 percent and the government 5 percent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: The analyst estimated the Nashpa find adds about PKR 1.5 per share to OGDC's earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: The analyst said Nashpa output could rise to about 6,600 barrels of oil per day as further exploratory wells are planned.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: The analyst said the Nashpa find would add a similar amount, about PKR 1.5 per share, to PPL's earnings.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: OGDC received monthly payments of about PKR 8 billion, which the analyst said was about the third or fourth month of such receipts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: The analyst said better gas collections boost OGDC and PPL liquidity and their capacity to pay quarterly dividends, which had been small.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: Biafo Industries' accounts for March 2025 recorded that its agreement had been signed, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: PTC has the second-largest paid-up capital of any listed company after OGDC, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: The analyst expected PTC's consolidated accounts after the Telenor transaction to look much better, with broadband revenue growing sharply.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: The analyst said 2026 could be better for stock market investors and new account holders, but advised taking profits after the rally.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)

fact_text: The analyst said Pakistan could earn about USD 10 billion in 2030 to 2032 from Reko Diq related projects.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 01 Jan 2026 | E&P Sector Rally | Nashpa Oil Discovery | OGDCL | PPL | PIBTL | BIAFO' (YouTube, 2026-01-01)
